content.statement: The current returns policy v2 explicitly sets a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, matching the claimed current window.
content.plan: Extracted numeric return windows from the bundled policy artifacts, compared the current returns_policy_v2 value (30 days) to the claimed value (30 days) and to the stale base artifacts (14 days), computed the delta and relative error, and checked the 10-day standard order against both windows; no n/mean/sd fields were present, so a two-sample t-test was not computable.
